args.body:
- Newsletter (Ironbark Tooling, "Freight pricing this quarter"): points readers to the blog article and offers a companion piece tailored to the reader's company.
- Main article (blog.ironbark.example/2026/freight): spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Companion piece (insights.ironbark.example): shippers who split their volume across three carriers paid the least.
args.title: Ironbark Tooling: Freight Pricing This Quarter
